title: White
summary: White Motor Company (later renamed White Motor Corporation and commonly known as White) was an American car, truck, bus and agricultural tractor manufacturer from 1900 until 1980. The company also produced bicycles, roller skates, automatic lathes, and sewing machines. Before World War II, the company was based in Cleveland, Ohio.

title: W Motors
summary: W Motors SAL is an Emirati sports car manufacturing company based in Dubai that develops high-performance luxury sports cars. The company's activities include automotive design, research and development, as well as vehicle engineering and manufacture. W Motors launched its first prototype model, the Lykan HyperSport, at the Qatar International Motor Show in January 2013.
